summary: CRITICAL: PR #288 restores trusted hardening imports, but its supposedly successful pr-ownership run proves the V2.1 facade is fail-open. tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening.py calls `_base.main()` without `raise SystemExit(...)`, so a base ControlError returns integer 2 that the facade discards and the Python process exits 0. Run 31465489200 / job 93697426938 printed `SWARM CONTROL ERROR: ... SWARM-RECOVERY-PR-OWNERSHIP-IMPORT.json: priority out of range` during Enforce live ownership, yet GitHub marked the step/job successful. The live duplicate recovery lane has priority 20000 while core validation permits at most 10000. Do not merge #288 as a complete ownership recovery until exit propagation is fixed and live control state validates cleanly; then rerun a real pr-check and require visible PASS output, not only a green job conclusion.
evidence: tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening.py __main__ block invokes `_base.main()` without `raise SystemExit`, unlike tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening_base.py which uses `raise SystemExit(main())`.

Swarm Control Plane run 31465489200, pr-ownership job 93697426938: trusted materialization/import succeeds, then Enforce live ownership prints `SWARM CONTROL ERROR: ... SWARM-RECOVERY-PR-OWNERSHIP-IMPORT.json: priority out of range`; GitHub still records the step and job success.
tools/swarm/swarmctl.py validate_lane permits priority only in [0, 10000]; live .swarm/lanes/SWARM-RECOVERY-PR-OWNERSHIP-IMPORT.json declares priority 20000.
PR #288 acceptance requires ownership enforcement to pass on the repair PR; a swallowed ControlError is not PASS evidence.
